package.description: A terminal watchlist for open-source contributors

en-US.description: A terminal watchlist for open-source contributors
en-US.longDescription: Follow watched GitHub repositories, catch up on activity, discover issues, and organize repositories with private local tags and saved filters. Requires GitHub CLI authentication for live data; demo mode works offline.
en-US.name: gh-wanted
en-US.releaseNotes:
Manual repository tracking
- In Repos, press + and enter owner/repo or a GitHub repository URL to track an accessible repository locally.
- Tracked repositories survive refreshes and appear in Today, Issues, and saved focuses.
- Press Enter, then x in repository details to remove local tracking. GitHub subscriptions are unchanged; watched repositories remain visible.

Upgrade note
The local database upgrades to schema 4 while preserving cached data and tags. Older versions cannot open the upgraded database; keep a pre-upgrade backup if you need to downgrade.
Download the archive for your platform below. GitHub CLI (gh) is required; run gh auth login before starting.
